summary: Qingdao works well for sea-breeze city travel combining coast walks, red-roof old quarters, casual seafood culture, and relaxed day-to-evening movement.
transport_notes: Plans work best when old-city slopes, seafront walks, and food zones are grouped by coastline section.
Short rides plus walking are often better than jumping between far-apart beaches in one day.
Evenings are strongest when kept near coastal promenades or beer-and-seafood districts.

budget_notes.low: Focus on public seafront walks, old-quarter streets, and straightforward local seafood or snack areas.
budget_notes.medium: Combine one coastal viewpoint, one old-city district, and one recognizable food area each day.
budget_notes.high: Add slower sea-view dining, more comfortable pacing, and polished waterfront breaks.

trip_type_notes.student: Student trips in Qingdao should feel breezy, casual, and full of affordable street-level sea-city experiences.
trip_type_notes.solo: Solo plans should emphasize coast wandering, neighborhood observation, and easy scenic transitions.
trip_type_notes.couple: Couple plans should focus on sea views, soft light, and relaxed old-town-to-waterfront pacing.
trip_type_notes.family: Family plans should favor broad promenades, easier coastal parks, and low-friction dining.

pois.name: Badaguan Area
pois.description: A scenic district combining villas, tree-lined roads, and easy sea-adjacent walking.

pois.name: Zhanqiao Pier Area
pois.description: A recognizable Qingdao landmark that works well as an old-city-seafront starting point.

pois.name: Xiaoyushan Viewpoint
pois.description: A strong panoramic stop for reading Qingdao's red roofs and coastline together.

pois.name: Signal Hill Park Area
pois.description: A useful hill-and-old-town contrast with a lighter walking feel than longer coastal routes.

pois.name: May Fourth Square Waterfront
pois.description: A broader public seafront zone suited to evening movement, skyline views, and open-air pacing.

pois.name: Pichaiyuan Old Street Area
pois.description: A practical old-quarter stop for local snacks, dense street life, and approachable city texture.

food_areas.name: Pichaiyuan Snack Area
food_areas.note: Best for affordable, lively eating with recognizable old-city character.

food_areas.name: Taidong Casual Food Streets
food_areas.note: Best for denser, practical local food with stronger urban energy.

food_areas.name: Waterfront Seafood Dining Zone
food_areas.note: Best for slower meals and sea-breeze atmosphere near evening walks.
